items.claim: Ravena Oliveira is a Muay Thai striker with offensive takedowns who likes to stalk forward.
items.quote: She's taking on Ravena Oliveira, a Muay Thai striker who has some offensive takedowns. She likes to stalk forward

items.claim: Ravena Oliveira has a 100% finish rate in her wins.
items.quote: she has a 100% finish rate in her wins

items.claim: Ravena Oliveira is coming off a knockout loss to Chanel Dyer where she moved herself right into a power punch.
items.quote: She is coming off that knockout loss to Chanel Dyer where she was game, she wasn't afraid, she moved forward and she just moved herself right into a giant power punch.

items.claim: Juliana Miller relies on toughness and grit but has no actual skills.
items.quote: She relies on the toughness, relies on the grit, and sometimes that is all you need. I mean, yeah, her record is [ __ ] but she did beat four people and she did so with the toughness and with the grit, but she has no actual skills.

items.claim: Steven Asplund dropped from 500 lbs to 260 lbs without surgery, giving him great cardio, pressure, and good power.
items.quote: 6'5", he went from 500 lbs to 260 lbs, and he did it the old-fashioned way. No shot, no surgery, just hard work. And doing it the old-fashioned way means that for a big guy, he's got great cardio, he's got great pressure, and he's got good power.

items.claim: Steven Asplund can be taken down.
items.quote: He's a pretty durable guy, but he can be taken down.

items.claim: Steven Asplund is coming off a decision loss to Vitor Petrino where he dropped Vitor three times but couldn't defend takedowns and faded.
items.quote: He is coming off the decision loss though to Vitor Petrino, where he dropped Vitor three times, but he couldn't defend the takedowns, and he did seem to fade a little bit.

items.claim: Guierme Pat has a wild karate stance with a poor takedown defense and a lack of urgency.
items.quote: He's got that wild karate stance. He's constantly bouncing on the toes, and then he'll leap into the strikes... Takedown defense, however, not impressive. Neither is the sense of urgency

items.claim: Guierme Pat is coming off a decision loss to Thomas Peterson where hesitancy lost him the fight.
items.quote: He is coming off the decision loss to Thomas Peterson, where the hesitancy is what lost him that fight.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos is a Muay Thai striker who fights at range to avoid takedowns.
items.quote: Amanda Lemos, a Muay Thai striker for the most part, does a good job fighting at that Muay Thai range. And she does that because she wants to avoid takedowns at all cost.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos can lose scrambles and be put on her back.
items.quote: she can lose some scrambles, and she can have been put on her back.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos is coming off a recent loss to Gillian Robertson.
items.quote: And most recently, she just lost to Gillian Robertson

items.claim: Alexa Tonara is a forward pressure striker whose chin stays up in the air.
items.quote: Alexa Tonara, a forward pressure striker who literally marches forward. Her chin stays up in the air, and she just starts bombing.
